================================================================================
  Danbooru 词库智能匹配（查词工具）— 完整部署代码包
  整理时间: 2026-06-03
  用途: 在别处重新搭建完整的前后端服务
================================================================================

  目录结构
  ========
  dtags-deploy/
  ├── backend/
  │   ├── server.js              ← 后端主服务（Express）
  │   ├── package.json           ← Node.js 依赖
  │   ├── ecosystem.config.js    ← PM2 配置
  │   └── start-with-restart.sh  ← 自动重启脚本
  ├── frontend/
  │   ├── index.html             ← 前端页面（HTML/CSS/JS 全部在一起）
  │   ├── tags-core.json         ← 核心标签库（约 1.2MB）
  │   ├── tags-character.json    ← 角色标签库（约 285KB）
  │   ├── tags-copyright.json    ← 版权标签库（约 311KB）
  │   ├── keyword_index.json     ← 关键词索引（约 608KB）
  │   ├── concept_semantics.json ← 概念语义库（约 51KB）
  │   └── adjective_combos.json  ← 形容词组合（约 4KB）
  └── README.md

  部署步骤
  ========
  1. 安装 Node.js（v18+）
  2. 进入 backend 目录，运行：
     npm install
     cp ecosystem.config.js ecosystem.config.local.js  # 修改 LLM_API_KEY 等环境变量
     pm2 start ecosystem.config.local.js
     # 或者不用 PM2：node server.js
  3. 将 frontend 目录的所有文件放到后端可访问的静态路径
  4. 确保端口可访问（默认 3002）

  LLM 配置
  ========
  LLM_API_URL: 你的 OpenAI 兼容接口地址（如 https://litellm.talesofai.cn/v1/chat/completions）
  LLM_API_KEY: 你的 API Key
  默认模型: qwen3.5-plus-no-think（可在 server.js 中修改）

  CORS 配置
  =========
  server.js 中 ALLOWED_ORIGINS_3002 和 allowedOrigins 正则需修改为你的实际域名

================================================================================

// Get real IP
function getClientIp(req) {
  return req.headers['x-forwarded-for']?.split(',')[0]?.trim()
    || req.headers['x-real-ip']
    || req.socket?.remoteAddress
    || 'unknown';
}

// === Origin 校验中间件（POST/PUT/DELETE，CORS 之前） ===
const ALLOWED_ORIGINS_3002 = new Set([
  'https://claw-annuonie-p3002.talesofai.com',
  'https://claw-annuonie-p3003.talesofai.com',
  'https://claw-annuonie-p3004.talesofai.com',
  'https://claw-annuonie-pages.talesofai.com',
]);
app.use((req, res, next) => {
  if (['POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE'].includes(req.method)) {
    const origin = req.headers.origin;
    if (origin && !ALLOWED_ORIGINS_3002.has(origin)) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Origin not allowed' });
    }
  }
  next();
});

// CORS - 仅允许 *.talesofai.com
const allowedOrigins = /^https?:\/\/[\w-]+\.talesofai\.com(:\d+)?$/;
app.use(cors({
  origin: (origin, cb) => {
    if (!origin || allowedOrigins.test(origin)) return cb(null, true);
    cb(new Error('CORS blocked'));
  }
}));
app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));

// === 查询日志（完整记录） ===
const LOG_FILE = path.join(DATA_DIR, 'query_log.jsonl');

/**
 * 记录一次完整的 LLM 调用
 */
function logQuery(entry) {
  if (entry.cached && entry.nickname && entry.user_input) {
    try {
      if (fs.existsSync(LOG_FILE)) {
        const lines = fs.readFileSync(LOG_FILE, 'utf-8').trim().split('\
').filter(Boolean);
        if (lines.length > 0) {
          const last = JSON.parse(lines[lines.length - 1]);
          if (last.nickname === entry.nickname &&
              last.user_input === entry.user_input &&
              last.cached === true) {
            return null;
          }
        }
      }
    } catch { /* skip */ }
  }

  let userInput = entry.user_input || '';
  if (!userInput && entry.llm_messages && entry.llm_messages.length > 0) {
    const lastMsg = entry.llm_messages[entry.llm_messages.length - 1];
    if (lastMsg && lastMsg.content) {
      const descMatch = lastMsg.content.match(/用户描述[：:]\\s*"([^"]+)"/);
      if (descMatch) userInput = descMatch[1];
    }
  }

  const logEntry = {
    id: crypto.randomUUID(),
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    nickname: entry.nickname || 'anonymous',
    avatar: entry.avatar || '',
    user_input: entry.user_input || '',
    llm_messages: entry.llm_messages || [],
    llm_response: entry.llm_response || '',
    model: entry.model || '',
    result_count: entry.result_count || 0,
    duration_ms: entry.duration_ms || 0,
    cached: entry.cached || false,
    raw_request: entry.raw_request || null,
    raw_response: entry.raw_response || null,
    error: entry.error || null,
  };

  const line = JSON.stringify(logEntry) + '\
';
  fs.appendFileSync(LOG_FILE, line);

  if (entry.nickname) {
    const userFile = path.join(DATA_DIR, 'search_history', `\${entry.nickname}.jsonl`);
    // 从 llm_response 中解析 tags
    let tags = [];
    try {
      if (logEntry.llm_response) {
        const jsonMatch = logEntry.llm_response.match(/\\`\\`\\`(?:json)?\\s*(\\{[\\s\\S]*?\\})\\s*\\`\\`\\`/);
        const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonMatch ? jsonMatch[1] : logEntry.llm_response);
        tags = Array.isArray(parsed.tags) ? parsed.tags : [];
      }
    } catch {}
    fs.appendFileSync(userFile, JSON.stringify({
      timestamp: logEntry.timestamp,
      user_input: logEntry.user_input,
      result_count: logEntry.result_count,
      duration_ms: logEntry.duration_ms,
      cached: logEntry.cached,
      model: logEntry.model,
      tags: tags.length ? tags.slice(0, 30) : [],
    }) + '\
');
  }

  return logEntry;
}

// UUID 格式化
function formatUuid(raw) {
  if (!raw) return null;
  if (raw.includes('-')) return raw;
  if (raw.length === 32) {
    return raw.replace(/(.{8})(.{4})(.{4})(.{4})(.{12})/, '$1-$2-$3-$4-$5');
  }
  return raw;
}

// === JWT 解码 ===
function decodeJwtPayload(token) {
  try {
    const parts = token.split('.');
    if (parts.length !== 3) return null;
    const payload = parts[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
    const padded = payload.padEnd(payload.length + (4 - payload.length % 4) % 4, '=');
    return JSON.parse(Buffer.from(padded, 'base64').toString('utf8'));
  } catch { return null; }
}

function isTokenExpired(payload) {
  if (!payload) return true;
  const exp = payload.exp || payload.expires_at;
  if (!exp) return false;
  return exp < Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
}

// === Token 验证中间件 ===
const requireAuthToken = (req, res, next) => {
  const auth = req.headers['authorization'];
  if (!auth?.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
    return res.status(401).json({ error: '需要 Bearer Token' });
  }
  const token = auth.slice(7);
  const payload = decodeJwtPayload(token);
  if (!payload) return res.status(401).json({ error: '无效 token 格式' });
  if (isTokenExpired(payload)) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'token 已过期' });
  req.userToken = token;
  req.userPayload = payload;
  next();
};

const requireAuthTokenOrCookie = (req, res, next) => {
  let token = req.cookies?.auth_token;
  if (!token) {
    const auth = req.headers['authorization'];
    if (auth?.startsWith('Bearer ')) token = auth.slice(7);
  }
  if (!token) return res.status(401).json({ error: '需要认证' });
  const payload = decodeJwtPayload(token);
  if (payload && isTokenExpired(payload)) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'token 已过期' });
  req.userToken = token;
  req.userPayload = payload || { raw_token: true };
  next();
};

// === Token 验证登录接口 ===
app.post('/api/auth/verify', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { token } = req.body;
    if (!token) return res.status(400).json({ error: '缺少 token' });

    const payload = decodeJwtPayload(token);
    let rawUuid = '';
    let isJwt = false;
    if (payload && !isTokenExpired(payload)) {
      isJwt = true;
      rawUuid = payload.talesofai_uuid || payload.sub || payload.uuid || '';
    }

    let apiUuid = rawUuid;
    if (rawUuid.length === 32 && !rawUuid.includes('-')) {
      apiUuid = rawUuid.replace(/^(.{8})(.{4})(.{4})(.{4})(.+)$/, '$1-$2-$3-$4-$5');
    }

    let nickname = '未知用户';
    let avatar = '';
    let uuid = '';

    for (const apiHost of ['https://api.talesofai.com', NIETA_API]) {
      try {
        const profileResp = await axios.get(`\${apiHost}/v1/user/`, {
          headers: { 'x-token': token },
          timeout: 8000,
        });
        if (profileResp.data) {
          const pd = profileResp.data;
          uuid = pd?.uuid || apiUuid || rawUuid || '';
          nickname = pd?.nick_name || nickname;
          avatar = pd?.avatar_url || avatar;
          break;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.log(`[Auth] Profile fetch via \${apiHost}: \${e.message}`);
      }
    }

    if (!uuid) uuid = apiUuid || rawUuid;

    // 持久化用户资料
    if (rawUuid) {
      try {
        const profilesDir = path.join(__dirname, 'data', 'user_profiles');
        const tokensDir = path.join(__dirname, 'data', 'user_tokens');
        fs.mkdirSync(tokensDir, { recursive: true });
        const userFile = path.join(profilesDir, `\${uuid}.json`);
        let profile = { uuid, nickname, avatar, first_seen: new Date().toISOString() };
        if (fs.existsSync(userFile)) {
          const existing = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(userFile, 'utf-8'));
          profile.nickname = existing.nickname || nickname;
          profile.avatar = existing.avatar || avatar;
          profile.first_seen = existing.first_seen || profile.first_seen;
          if (nickname && nickname !== '未知用户') profile.nickname = nickname;
          if (avatar) profile.avatar = avatar;
        }
        profile.last_seen = new Date().toISOString();
        fs.writeFileSync(userFile, JSON.stringify(profile, null, 2));
        const tokenFile = path.join(tokensDir, `\${uuid}.json`);
        fs.writeFileSync(tokenFile, JSON.stringify({
          uuid, token,
          expires_at: payload && payload.exp ? new Date(payload.exp * 1000).toISOString() : null,
          saved_at: new Date().toISOString()
        }, null, 2));
      } catch (e) {
        console.log(`[Auth] Failed to save token: \${e.message}`);
      }
    }

    res.json({ success: true, nickname, avatar, uuid,
      expires_at: payload && payload.exp ? new Date(payload.exp * 1000).toISOString() : null });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: '验证失败: ' + e.message });
  }
});

// === Cookie-based auth ===
app.post('/api/auth/cookie-login', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { token } = req.body;
    if (!token) return res.status(400).json({ error: '缺少 token' });
    const payload = decodeJwtPayload(token);
    if (payload && isTokenExpired(payload)) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'token 已过期' });
    let rawUuid = '';
    if (payload) rawUuid = payload.talesofai_uuid || payload.sub || payload.uuid || '';
    let nickname = '未知用户', avatar = '';
    for (const apiHost of ['https://api.talesofai.com', NIETA_API]) {
      try {
        const pr = await axios.get(`\${apiHost}/v1/user/`, {
          headers: { 'x-token': token }, timeout: 8000,
        });
        if (pr.data) {
          nickname = pr.data?.nick_name || nickname;
          avatar = pr.data?.avatar_url || avatar;
          break;
        }
      } catch {}
    }
    res.cookie('auth_token', token, {
      httpOnly: true, secure: true, sameSite: 'lax',
      maxAge: 86400000, domain: '.talesofai.com', path: '/',
    });
    res.json({ success: true, nickname, avatar, uuid: rawUuid });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: '验证失败: ' + e.message });
  }
});

app.post('/api/auth/cookie-logout', (req, res) => {
  res.clearCookie('auth_token', { domain: '.talesofai.com', path: '/' });
  res.json({ ok: true });
});

app.get('/api/auth/me', requireAuthTokenOrCookie, async (req, res) => {
  const payload = req.userPayload;
  let uuid = payload?.uuid || payload?.talesofai_uuid || payload?.sub || '';
  let nickname = '未知用户', avatar = '';
  if (uuid) {
    try {
      const profilesDir = path.join(__dirname, 'data', 'user_profiles');
      const rawUuid = uuid.includes('-') ? uuid.replace(/-/g, '') : uuid;
      const dashedUuid = rawUuid.replace(/^(.{8})(.{4})(.{4})(.{4})(.+)$/, '$1-$2-$3-$4-$5');
      for (const candidate of [rawUuid, dashedUuid, uuid]) {
        const userFile = path.join(profilesDir, `\${candidate}.json`);
        if (fs.existsSync(userFile)) {
          const profile = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(userFile, 'utf-8'));
          nickname = profile.nickname || nickname;
          avatar = profile.avatar || avatar;
          break;
        }
      }
    } catch {}
  }
  res.json({ nickname, avatar, uuid });
});

// === 登录：解析角色链接 ===
app.post('/api/login', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    let { character_url } = req.body;
    if (!character_url) return res.status(400).json({ error: '缺少角色链接' });

    let uuid = null, resolvedUrl = null, fromUser = null;
    const uuidMatch = character_url.match(/([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})/i);
    if (uuidMatch) {
      uuid = uuidMatch[1];
    } else if (character_url.includes('t.nieta.art')) {
      try {
        const resp = await axios.get(`\${NIETA_API}/v1/util/original-url`, {
          params: { short_url: character_url }
        });
        resolvedUrl = typeof resp.data === 'string' ? resp.data : (resp.data?.url || resp.data?.original_url || '');
        const m = resolvedUrl.match(/([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})/i);
        if (m) uuid = m[1];
        const fu = resolvedUrl.match(/from_user=([a-f0-9]+)/i);
        if (fu) fromUser = fu[1];
      } catch {
        try {
          const resp = await axios.get(character_url, { maxRedirects: 0, validateStatus: s => s >= 300 && s < 400 });
          resolvedUrl = resp.headers?.location || '';
          const m = resolvedUrl.match(/([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})/i);
          if (m) uuid = m[1];
          const fu = resolvedUrl.match(/from_user=([a-f0-9]+)/i);
          if (fu) fromUser = fu[1];
        } catch {}
      }
    }

    if (!uuid) return res.status(400).json({ error: '无法解析角色UUID' });

    const profile = await axios.get(`\${NIETA_API}/v2/travel/parent/\${uuid}/profile`, {
      headers: { 'x-platform': 'nieta-app/web', 'x-nieta-app-version': '6.8.9' }
    });

    const d = profile.data;
    const nickname = d?.owner_profile?.nick_name || d?.creator?.nick_name || '未知用户';
    const avatar = d?.owner_profile?.avatar_url || d?.owner_profile?.avatar_img || d?.config?.avatar_img || d?.config?.header_img || '';
    const creatorUuid = d?.owner_profile?.uuid || d?.creator?.uuid || null;

    const ip = req.headers['x-forwarded-for'] || req.headers['x-real-ip'] || req.socket.remoteAddress || 'unknown';
    fs.appendFileSync(path.join(DATA_DIR, 'login_log.jsonl'), JSON.stringify({
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), uuid, nickname, ip,
      fromUser: fromUser || null, creatorUuid: creatorUuid || null,
    }) + '\
');

    res.json({ success: true, nickname, avatar });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Login error:', e.message);
    res.status(500).json({ error: '登录失败: ' + e.message });
  }
});

// === LLM 代理转发 ===
app.post('/api/chat', requireAuthTokenOrCookie, async (req, res) => {
  const { model, messages, max_tokens, temperature, user_input, nickname, avatar, skip_log } = req.body;

  let featureType = 'llm_match';
  if (messages && messages.length > 0) {
    const sysMsg = messages.find(m => m.role === 'system')?.content || '';
    if (sysMsg.includes('标签数量')) featureType = 'tag_count';
    else if (sysMsg.includes('只返回中文翻译文本')) featureType = 'tag_translate';
    else if (sysMsg.includes('只返回 JSON') && !sysMsg.includes('标签')) featureType = 'tag_analyze';
  }

  // 后端敏感词检测
  const inputToCheck = user_input || (messages?.[messages.length - 1]?.content) || '';
  const backendHit = backendKeywordCheck(inputToCheck);
  if (backendHit) {
    logQuery({
      nickname: nickname || 'anonymous', avatar: avatar || '',
      user_input: inputToCheck, llm_messages: [], llm_response: '',
      model: model || '', result_count: 0, duration_ms: 0, cached: false,
      raw_request: req.body, raw_response: null,
    });
    const entry = {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(), timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      nickname: nickname || 'anonymous', avatar: avatar || '',
      user_input: inputToCheck, violation_type: 'backend_blocked',
      violation_reason: `后端关键词拦截：\${backendHit.join('、')}`,
      severity: 'high',
    };
    fs.appendFileSync(VIOLATION_LOG, JSON.stringify(entry) + '\
');
    return res.status(403).json({ error: '输入包含不当内容，已记录报备', violation: true, keywords: backendHit });
  }

  // Check cache
  const cacheKey = crypto.createHash('md5').update(JSON.stringify({ model, messages })).digest('hex');
  if (cache.has(cacheKey)) {
    const cached = cache.get(cacheKey);
    if (Date.now() - cached.time < CACHE_TTL) {
      let actualCount = 0;
      const cachedText = cached.data?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '';
      try {
        const jsonMatch = cachedText.match(/\\`\\`\\`(?:json)?\\s*(\\{[\\s\\S]*?\\})\\s*\\`\\`\\`/);
        const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonMatch ? jsonMatch[1] : cachedText);
        actualCount = Array.isArray(parsed.tags) ? parsed.tags.length : 0;
      } catch {}
      if (actualCount === 0 && cachedText) actualCount = 1;

      if (!skip_log) {
        logQuery({
          nickname: nickname || 'anonymous', avatar: avatar || '',
          user_input: user_input || '', llm_messages: messages || [],
          llm_response: cachedText, model: cached.data?.model || model || '',
          result_count: actualCount, duration_ms: 0, cached: true,
          raw_request: req.body, raw_response: cached.data,
        });
      }
      return res.json(cached.data);
    }
    cache.delete(cacheKey);
  }

  const startTime = Date.now();
  try {
    const response = await axios.post(LLM_API_URL, {
      model: model || 'qwen3.5-plus-no-think',
      messages, max_tokens: max_tokens || 4096, temperature: temperature ?? 0.5
    }, {
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Authorization': `Bearer \${LLM_API_KEY}`
      },
      timeout: 60000
    });

    const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
    cache.set(cacheKey, { data: response.data, time: Date.now() });

    const llmResponseText = response.data?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '';
    if (!skip_log) {
      let actualCount = 0;
      try {
        const jsonMatch = llmResponseText.match(/\\`\\`\\`(?:json)?\\s*(\\{[\\s\\S]*?\\})\\s*\\`\\`\\`/);
        const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonMatch ? jsonMatch[1] : llmResponseText);
        actualCount = Array.isArray(parsed.tags) ? parsed.tags.length : 0;
      } catch {}
      if (actualCount === 0 && llmResponseText) actualCount = 1;
      logQuery({
        nickname: nickname || 'anonymous', avatar: avatar || '',
        user_input: user_input || '', llm_messages: messages || [],
        llm_response: llmResponseText, model: response.data?.model || model || '',
        result_count: actualCount, duration_ms: duration, cached: false,
        raw_request: req.body, raw_response: response.data,
      });
    }
    res.json(response.data);
  } catch (e) {
    const error = e.response?.data?.error?.message || e.message;
    if (!skip_log) {
      logQuery({
        nickname: nickname || 'anonymous', avatar: avatar || '',
        user_input: user_input || '', llm_messages: messages || [],
        llm_response: '', model: model || '', result_count: 0,
        duration_ms: Date.now() - startTime, cached: false,
        raw_request: req.body, raw_response: null, error,
      });
    }
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'LLM 请求失败: ' + error });
  }
});

const TAG_FILES = {
  'core': 'tags-core.json',
  'copyright': 'tags-copyright.json',
  'character': 'tags-character.json',
  'keyword_index': 'keyword_index.json',
  'concept_semantics': 'concept_semantics.json',
  'adjective_combos': 'adjective_combos.json'
};

app.get('/api/data/:name', (req, res) => {
  const filename = TAG_FILES[req.params.name];
  if (!filename) return res.status(404).json({ error: '未知数据文件' });
  const filepath = path.join(TAGS_DIR, filename);
  if (!fs.existsSync(filepath)) return res.status(404).json({ error: '文件不存在' });
  try {
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
    res.send(fs.readFileSync(filepath, 'utf-8'));
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: '读取失败: ' + e.message });
  }
});

// === 个人搜索历史 ===
app.get('/api/history/:nickname', (req, res) => {
  const nickname = req.params.nickname;
  const filepath = path.join(DATA_DIR, 'query_log.jsonl');
  if (!fs.existsSync(filepath)) return res.json([]);
  try {
    const lines = fs.readFileSync(filepath, 'utf-8').trim().split('\
').filter(Boolean);
    // 按 nickname 过滤，提取 tags
    const userEntries = [];
    for (let i = lines.length - 1; i >= 0 && userEntries.length < 50; i--) {
      const entry = JSON.parse(lines[i]);
      if (entry.nickname === nickname) {
        let tags = [];
        try {
          if (entry.llm_response) {
            const jsonMatch = entry.llm_response.match(/\\`\\`\\`(?:json)?\\s*(\\{[\\s\\S]*?\\})\\s*\\`\\`\\`/);
            const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonMatch ? jsonMatch[1] : entry.llm_response);
            tags = Array.isArray(parsed.tags) ? parsed.tags : [];
          }
        } catch {}
        userEntries.push({
          timestamp: entry.timestamp,
          user_input: entry.user_input,
          result_count: entry.result_count,
          duration_ms: entry.duration_ms,
          cached: entry.cached,
          model: entry.model,
          tags: tags.slice(0, 30),
        });
      }
    }
    res.json(userEntries.reverse());
  } catch { res.json([]); }
});

  favs.push({ ...req.body, saved_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  fs.writeFileSync(filepath, JSON.stringify(favs, null, 2));
  res.json({ success: true, count: favs.length });
});

// === 管理员：全部用户列表 ===
app.get('/api/admin/users', (req, res) => {
  const filepath = path.join(DATA_DIR, 'query_log.jsonl');
  if (!fs.existsSync(filepath)) return res.json({ total_users: 0, users: [] });
  try {
    const lines = fs.readFileSync(filepath, 'utf-8').trim().split('\
').filter(Boolean);
    const userMap = {};
    lines.map(l => JSON.parse(l)).forEach(e => {
      const nick = e.nickname || 'anonymous';
      if (!userMap[nick]) userMap[nick] = { nickname: nick, avatar: e.avatar || '', query_count: 0, first_seen: e.timestamp, last_seen: e.timestamp, ips: new Set() };
      userMap[nick].query_count++;
      if (e.timestamp < userMap[nick].first_seen) userMap[nick].first_seen = e.timestamp;
      if (e.timestamp > userMap[nick].last_seen) userMap[nick].last_seen = e.timestamp;
      if (e.ip) userMap[nick].ips.add(e.ip);
    });
    const users = Object.values(userMap).sort((a, b) => b.last_seen.localeCompare(a.last_seen));
    res.json({ total_users: users.length, users: users.map(u => ({ ...u, ips: [...u.ips] })) });
  } catch { res.json({ total_users: 0, users: [] }); }
});

// === 管理员：统计 ===
app.get('/api/admin/stats', (req, res) => {
  const filepath = path.join(DATA_DIR, 'query_log.jsonl');
  if (!fs.existsSync(filepath)) return res.json({ total_users: 0, total_queries: 0, top_users: [], hot_terms: [], daily_trend: [] });
  try {
    const entries = fs.readFileSync(filepath, 'utf-8').trim().split('\
').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
    const userCount = {};
    entries.forEach(e => { userCount[e.nickname] = (userCount[e.nickname] || 0) + 1; });
    const topUsers = Object.entries(userCount).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 10).map(([n, c]) => ({ name: n, count: c }));
    const termCount = {};
    entries.forEach(e => {
      if (e.user_input) e.user_input.split(/[,，\\s]+/).forEach(t => { t = t.trim(); if (t.length > 0) termCount[t] = (termCount[t] || 0) + 1; });
    });
    const hotTerms = Object.entries(termCount).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 20).map(([t, c]) => ({ term: t, count: c }));
    const dayCount = {};
    entries.forEach(e => { const day = e.timestamp?.substring(0, 10) || 'unknown'; dayCount[day] = (dayCount[day] || 0) + 1; });
    const dailyTrend = Object.entries(dayCount).sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0])).slice(-30);
    res.json({ total_users: Object.keys(userCount).length, total_queries: entries.length, top_users: topUsers, hot_terms: hotTerms, daily_trend: dailyTrend });
  } catch { res.json({ total_users: 0, total_queries: 0, top_users: [], hot_terms: [], daily_trend: [] }); }
});

// === 后端敏感词二次检测 ===
const BACKEND_SENSITIVE_WORDS = [
  '露点','性交','性爱','做爱','操逼','鸡巴','屌','奶子','乳房','乳交',
  '肛交','口交','阴部','阴道','阴茎','射精','高潮','裸体','全裸',
  '淫荡','淫乱','乱伦','强奸','猥亵','嫖娼','卖淫','三级片',
  'AV','a片','小电影','毛片','黄片','成人片','色情片',
  '骚','骚货','骚逼','屎','尿','屁','屎尿屁',
  '杀人','屠杀','砍头','斩首','分尸','凌迟','虐待','折磨',
  '血腥','血腥场面','血腥暴力','尸体','尸块',
  '冰毒','海洛因','可卡因','大麻','摇头丸','K粉',
  '制毒','贩毒','吸毒','毒品','嗑药','溜冰',
  '自杀','自残','自焚','割腕','上吊','跳楼',
  '爆炸物','炸弹','炸药','枪支','弹药',
];

function backendKeywordCheck(text) {
  if (!text) return null;
  const lower = text.toLowerCase();
  const hit = BACKEND_SENSITIVE_WORDS.filter(w => lower.includes(w));
  return hit.length > 0 ? hit : null;
}

// === 轻量登录上报（带去重） ===
const loginSeen = new Map();
app.post('/api/report-login', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { nickname, avatar, uuid: frontendUuid, character_url } = req.body;
    if (!nickname) return res.status(400).json({ error: '缺少昵称' });
    const ip = req.headers['x-forwarded-for'] || req.headers['x-real-ip'] || req.socket.remoteAddress || 'unknown';
    const ipStr = String(ip).split(',')[0].trim();
    let fromUser = null, creatorUuid = frontendUuid || null, shareSource = 'direct_link', resolvedUrl = null;
    if (character_url) {
      const fu = character_url.match(/from_user=([a-f0-9-]+)/i);
      if (fu) fromUser = fu[1];
      if (!creatorUuid && character_url.includes('t.nieta.art')) {
        try {
          const resp = await axios.get(`\${NIETA_API}/v1/util/original-url`, { params: { short_url: character_url } });
          resolvedUrl = typeof resp.data === 'string' ? resp.data : (resp.data?.url || resp.data?.original_url || '');
          const m = resolvedUrl.match(/([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})/i);
          if (m) creatorUuid = m[1];
          const fu2 = resolvedUrl.match(/from_user=([a-f0-9-]+)/i);
          if (fu2) fromUser = fu2[1];
        } catch (e) { console.log(`[report-login] resolve failed: \${e.message}`); }
      }
      if (fromUser && creatorUuid) shareSource = (fromUser !== creatorUuid) ? 'other_share' : 'self_share';
      else if (fromUser) shareSource = 'from_user_only';
    }
    const seen = loginSeen.get(nickname);
    if (seen && seen.ip === ipStr && seen.shareSource === shareSource) return res.json({ ok: true, dedup: true });
    loginSeen.set(nickname, { ip: ipStr, shareSource });
    res.json({ ok: true });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[report-login] error:', e.message);
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

// === 管理员：异常检测 ===
app.get('/api/admin/anomalies', (req, res) => {
  const anomalies = [];
  try {
    const filepath = path.join(DATA_DIR, 'query_log.jsonl');
    if (fs.existsSync(filepath)) {
      const entries = fs.readFileSync(filepath, 'utf-8').trim().split('\
').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
      const cutoff = Date.now() - 600000;
      const recent = entries.filter(e => new Date(e.timestamp).getTime() > cutoff);
      const userRecent = {};
      recent.forEach(e => { userRecent[e.nickname] = (userRecent[e.nickname] || 0) + 1; });
      Object.entries(userRecent).filter(([_, count]) => count > 50).forEach(([name, count]) => {
        anomalies.push({ type: 'frequency', nickname: name, count, window: '10min', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
      });
    }
  } catch {}
  try {
    if (fs.existsSync(VIOLATION_LOG)) {
      const entries = fs.readFileSync(VIOLATION_LOG, 'utf-8').trim().split('\
').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
      const cutoff = Date.now() - 86400000;
      entries.reverse().forEach(e => {
        if (new Date(e.timestamp).getTime() > cutoff) anomalies.push({ ...e, type: 'violation' });
      });
    }
  } catch {}
  res.json(anomalies);
});

app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`dtags-backend running on port \${PORT}`);
});

================================================================================
  第四部分：start-with-restart.sh（自动重启脚本）
  文件位置: dtags-deploy/backend/start-with-restart.sh
  说明: 不用 PM2 时的简易自动重启方案
================================================================================

#!/bin/sh
# dtags-backend (3002) 自动重启包装器
cd /home/node/.openclaw/workspace/dtags-backend
while true; do
  node server.js >> server.log 2>&1
  echo "[$(date -Iseconds)] 进程退出，3s 后重启..." >> server.log
  sleep 3
done

核心原则：
1. 理解意图，不逐字翻译——像一个美术师构思画面那样思考

6. 输出只返回 JSON，不要其他内容

// === 统一禁止标签常量 ===
const FORBIDDEN_TAGS = new Set([
  'smile','smirk','grin','open_mouth','closed_mouth','teeth','tongue','pout','blush',
  'expressionless','expressionless_face',':d',':p',':q',
  'looking_at_viewer','looking_away','looking_back','looking_up','looking_down',

// 过滤颜色变体：如果基础款存在（如 sweater_vest），则移除颜色前缀版本（如 black_sweater_vest）
function filterColorVariants(tags) {
  const tagNames = new Set(tags.map(t => t.name));
  const result = [];
  for (const tag of tags) {
    const parts = tag.name.toLowerCase().split('_');
    let isColorVariant = false;
    for (const color of COLOR_PREFIXES) {
      const colorParts = color.split('_');
      if (parts.slice(0, colorParts.length).join('_') === color) {
        const base = parts.slice(colorParts.length).join('_');
        // 如果基础款存在，跳过颜色变体
        if (base && tagNames.has(base)) {
          isColorVariant = true;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if (!isColorVariant) result.push(tag);
  }
  return result;
}

// Fetch with retry
async function fetchWithRetry(url, retries = 3, timeout = 15000) {
  for (let i = 0; i < retries; i++) {
    try {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeout);
      const res = await fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal });
      clearTimeout(timer);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      return await res.json();
    } catch (e) {
      if (i === retries - 1) throw e;
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000 * (i + 1)));
    }
  }
}

// Parse compact tag array → object
function parseTag(arr) {
  return { name: arr[0], category: arr[1], post_count: arr[2], zh: arr[3] || '', is_deprecated: false };
}

async function loadData() {
  try {
    // Load core tags first (general + artist) — ~1.19MB
    const coreData = await fetchWithRetry(DATA_BASE + 'tags-core.json');
    coreData.forEach(arr => {
      const t = parseTag(arr);
      allTags.push(t);
      tagMap.set(t.name.toLowerCase(), t);
    });
    coreLoaded = true;
    updateStats();

    // Load keyword index and concept semantics in parallel
    const [indexData, conceptData, comboData] = await Promise.all([
      fetchWithRetry(DATA_BASE + 'keyword_index.json'),
      fetchWithRetry(DATA_BASE + 'concept_semantics.json').catch(() => ({})),
      fetchWithRetry(DATA_BASE + 'adjective_combos.json').catch(() => ({}))
    ]);
    keywordIndex = indexData;
    conceptSemantics = conceptData;
    adjectiveCombos = comboData;

    // Lazy load copyright + character in background (non-blocking)
    loadOptionalTags();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Load failed:', e);
    showToast('数据加载失败，请刷新重试');
  }
}

async function loadOptionalTags() {
  const statusEl = document.getElementById('loadStatus');
  // Load copyright
  try {
    statusEl.textContent = '加载版权标签中...';
    const data = await fetchWithRetry(DATA_BASE + 'tags-copyright.json');
    data.forEach(arr => {
      const t = parseTag(arr);
      allTags.push(t);
      tagMap.set(t.name.toLowerCase(), t);
    });
    copyrightLoaded = true;
    updateStats();
  } catch (e) { console.warn('Copyright tags load failed:', e); }

  // Load character
  try {
    statusEl.textContent = '加载角色标签中...';
    const data = await fetchWithRetry(DATA_BASE + 'tags-character.json');
    data.forEach(arr => {
      const t = parseTag(arr);
      allTags.push(t);
      tagMap.set(t.name.toLowerCase(), t);
    });
    characterLoaded = true;
    updateStats();
  } catch (e) { console.warn('Character tags load failed:', e); }

  if (copyrightLoaded && characterLoaded) {
    statusEl.textContent = '';
  } else {
    statusEl.textContent = copyrightLoaded && characterLoaded ? '' : '部分标签加载失败，刷新可重试';
  }
}

function updateStats() {
  document.getElementById('totalTags').textContent = allTags.length.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById('generalCount').textContent = allTags.filter(t => t.category === 'general').length.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById('charCount').textContent = allTags.filter(t => t.category === 'character').length.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById('copyCount').textContent = allTags.filter(t => t.category === 'copyright').length.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById('footerCount').textContent = allTags.length.toLocaleString();
}

// === 登录系统（iframe 捏Ta 登录，postMessage 获取 token） ===

function showLoginMsg(text, type = '') {
  const msg = document.getElementById('loginMsg');
  if (!msg) return;
  msg.style.display = 'block';
  msg.style.background = type === 'err' ? '#fff2f5' : type === 'ok' ? '#f2fff7' : '#f7f7fb';
  msg.style.color = type === 'err' ? '#a12d49' : type === 'ok' ? '#23734c' : '#5d5d6a';
  msg.textContent = text;
  if (type !== 'loading') setTimeout(() => { msg.style.display = 'none'; }, 4000);
}

// 监听 iframe 登录成功消息
window.addEventListener('message', async (event) => {
  try {
    if (event.data && event.data.type === 'PAGE_PHONE_LOGIN_SUCCESS') {
      const payload = event.data.payload;
      const token = payload?.token || '';

      if (!token) {
        showLoginMsg('登录失败：未获取到 token', 'err');
        return;
      }

      showLoginMsg('登录成功，正在获取用户信息...', 'ok');

      try {
        const profileRes = await fetch('/api/nieta/profile', {
          headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token },
        });
        let profile = null;
        try { profile = await profileRes.json(); } catch {}

        const nickname = profile?.nick_name || profile?.nickname || profile?.name || '捏Ta用户';
        const avatar = profile?.avatar_url || profile?.avatar_img || profile?.avatar || '';
        const uuid = profile?.uuid || '';

        userToken = token;
        currentUser = { nickname, avatar, uuid };
        localStorage.setItem('kt', token);
        localStorage.setItem('NIETA_ACCESS_TOKEN', token);
        if (payload.refresh_token) localStorage.setItem('NIETA_REFRESH_TOKEN', payload.refresh_token);
        localStorage.setItem('ku', uuid);
        localStorage.setItem('kn', nickname);
        localStorage.setItem('dtags_user_v2', JSON.stringify(currentUser));

        setTimeout(() => showWelcome(currentUser), 600);
      } catch (e) {
        userToken = token;
        currentUser = { nickname: '捏Ta用户', avatar: '', uuid: '' };
        localStorage.setItem('kt', token);
        localStorage.setItem('NIETA_ACCESS_TOKEN', token);
        localStorage.setItem('dtags_user_v2', JSON.stringify(currentUser));
        showLoginMsg('登录成功！', 'ok');
        setTimeout(() => showWelcome(currentUser), 600);
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Login message handler error:', e);
  }
});

function typewriterWelcomeName(name) {

      el.textContent = name.substring(0, i);
      i++;
      setTimeout(type, 120);
    } else {
      setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('cursor-blink'), 2000);

  };
  type();
}

function checkSavedLogin() {
  // 检查 localStorage 中保存的 token（跟 3004 token-admin 一致）
  const kn = localStorage.getItem('kn');
  const ku = localStorage.getItem('ku');
  const kt = localStorage.getItem('kt');
  const saved = localStorage.getItem('dtags_user_v2');

  if (kn && ku) {
    // 先检查 JWT 是否过期
    if (kt) {
      const jwtCheck = validateJwtFormat(kt);
      if (!jwtCheck.valid) {
        // Token 已过期，清除登录状态
        localStorage.removeItem('kt');
        localStorage.removeItem('ku');
        localStorage.removeItem('kn');
        localStorage.removeItem('dtags_user_v2');
        return;
      }
    }
    currentUser = JSON.parse(saved || `{"nickname":"${kn}","avatar":"","uuid":"${ku}"}`);
    if (kt) userToken = kt;
    showWelcome(currentUser);
    return;
  }
}

// 页面加载时检查登录状态
checkSavedLogin();

// 根据输入长度动态决定返回关键词数量
function getTagCountRange(input) {
  const len = input.length;
  if (len <= 4) return { min: 8, max: 15 };       // "头发" → 至少8个
  if (len <= 10) return { min: 12, max: 22 };     // "红色长发" → 至少12个
  if (len <= 20) return { min: 18, max: 30 };     // "红色长发，蓝色眼睛" → 至少18个
  if (len <= 40) return { min: 25, max: 45 };     // 长描述 → 大量
  return { min: 30, max: 60 };                    // 很长描述 → 最多
}

// === 容错 JSON 解析：修复 LLM 常见输出错误 ===
function parseLenientJSON(raw) {
  if (!raw) return null;
  let s = raw.trim();
  // 1. 直接试
  try { return JSON.parse(s); } catch {}
  // 2. 修复末尾截断：去掉最后一个未闭合的键值对
  try {
    let fixed = s.replace(/,\s*"[^"]*$/, '').replace(/,\s*'[^']*$/, '');
    fixed = fixed.replace(/"[^"]*$/, '"');
    fixed = fixed.replace(/,\s*$/, '');
    fixed = fixed.replace(/\}[^}]*$/, '}');
    fixed = fixed.replace(/\][^\]]*$/, ']');
    return JSON.parse(fixed);
  } catch {}
  // 3. 修复未闭合的字符串值：补上缺的引号和逗号
  try {
    let fixed = s.replace(/:\s*"([^"]*?)(?=[,\n\r}])/g, ':"$1"');
    fixed = fixed.replace(/:\s*([^",\s][^,\n]*?)(?=[,\n}])/g, (m, p) => {
      if (/^\d|^\[|^\{|^true|^false|^null/.test(p.trim())) return m;
      return ':"' + p.trim() + '"';
    });
    return JSON.parse(fixed);
  } catch {}
  // 4. 从 tags 数组里硬捞
  try {
    const tm = s.match(/"tags"\s*:\s*\[([^\]]*)/);
    if (tm) {
      const items = tm[1].split(',').map(t => t.trim().replace(/^"|"$/g, '').replace(/\\u/g, '%')).filter(Boolean);
      return { tags: items };
    }
  } catch {}
  return null;
}

// === LLM 中文翻译 → Danbooru 英文关键词（方案二核心）===
async function translateToDanbooru(userInput, matchedConcept) {
  const countRange = getTagCountRange(userInput);

  const conceptHint = matchedConcept ? `
=== 概念融合 ===
用户描述中包含概念词「${matchedConcept.name}」，英文：${matchedConcept.en}。
氛围关键词：${matchedConcept.vibe} | 详细线索：${matchedConcept.hints}
建议标签参考：${matchedConcept.related_tags.join(', ')}

融合方法：概念是整体风格指引，不是具体视觉元素。让概念氛围渗透到每个视觉元素中：
- "梦核，红色长发" → liminal_space, dreamlike_red_hair, surreal_eyes, uncanny_atmosphere（不是 dreamcore + red_hair 分开）
- "赛博朋克，白色连衣裙" → neon_lights, cyberpunk_dress, futuristic_fabric, glowing_trim（不是 cyberpunk + white_dress 分开）
` : '';

  const prompt = `${LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT}

=== 📋 拆解视觉元素 ===

逐个拆解用户描述中的每个视觉元素，对每个元素推导 3-6 个 Danbooru 标签。
示例："彩虹拟人，小蛋糕元素"
→ 元素1：彩虹（颜色/光谱/折射）→ prism, iridescent_skin, rainbow_gradient, refraction, multicolored_hair, crystal
→ 元素2：拟人（非人→人形）→ anthropomorphic + 该生物的具体特征
→ 元素3：小蛋糕（甜点/装饰）→ frosting, sprinkles, whipped_cream, cherry, cupcake, pastel_sweets

=== 🧠 深度翻译 ===

不要照搬字面意思！要像画师构思画面那样推导：
- "蚊子拟人" → 不只是 mosquito + anthropomorphic，而是 proboscis, translucent_wings, thin_limbs, compound_eyes, chelicerae
- "梦核，白色连衣裙" → 不只是 dreamcore + white_dress，而是 liminal_space, faded_white_dress, uncanny_aesthetic, pastel_palette

意象群参考：
- "彩虹" → prism, iridescent, rainbow_gradient, colorful, multicolored, refraction, crystal
- "蛋糕甜点" → frosting, sprinkles, whipped_cream, cherry, pastel, sweet
- "火焰" → embers, smoke, ash, heat_haze, warm_lighting, burning
- "冰雪" → snowflake, frost, ice_crystal, cold_lighting, translucent, frozen
- "海洋" → wave, sea_foam, coral, pearl, translucent, wet
- "花" → petals, pollen, flower_ornament, floral_print, bloom
- "月亮" → crescent, moonlight, lunar_glow, night_sky, pale
- "机械" → gears, mechanical_parts, metallic, cyborg, circuit

=== 🔗 组合词推导 ===

推导公式：{修饰词} + {基础元素} = 组合标签
修饰词：silk, leather, lace, flame, ice, lightning, smoke, crystal, glowing, iridescent, broken, cracked, melting, burning, gothic, tribal, red, blue, silver, gold...
基础元素：dress, coat, hair, eyes, wings, tail, halo, crown, markings, aura, petals...
组合示例：
- "燃烧的衣摆" → burning_clothes, flame_trim, flame_print
- "液态光环" → glowing_halo, wet, translucent
- "碎裂的水晶瞳孔" → crystal_eyes, gemstone_eyes, cracked_skin

**关键：从你的标签应该能反推出用户的原始描述。如果做不到，说明标签太泛泛了。**

${conceptHint}
用户描述："${userInput}"
返回 ${countRange.min}-${countRange.max} 个标签。

返回 JSON 格式：
{
  "decomposition": [
    {"element": "用户描述中的视觉元素", "derived_tags": ["标签1", "标签2", "标签3"]}
  ],
  "tags": ["keyword1", "keyword2", ...]
}

decomposition 字段：逐个拆解每个视觉元素，对每个元素列出 3-6 个候选标签。
tags 字段：从所有 derived_tags 中挑选最有辨识度的 ${countRange.min}-${countRange.max} 个，每个必须能追溯到具体元素。`;

  try {
    const r = await fetch(CHAT_PROXY_URL, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify({ model: MODEL, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT }, { role: 'user', content: prompt }], max_tokens: countRange.max * 8, temperature: 0.1, user_input: document.getElementById('userInput').value, nickname: currentUser?.nickname, avatar: currentUser?.avatar, skip_log: true }),
      credentials: 'include',
    });
    const d = await r.json();
    const c = d.choices[0].message.content;
    const codeBlock = c.match(/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*```/);
    let jsonStr = codeBlock ? codeBlock[1].trim() : c.trim();
    // If no code block found, try to extract JSON object
    if (!codeBlock) {
      const jsonMatch = c.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
      if (jsonMatch) jsonStr = jsonMatch[0];
    }
    const parsed = parseLenientJSON(jsonStr);
    if (parsed && parsed.tags) return parsed.tags;
    console.warn('LLM translation failed: invalid JSON', jsonStr.substring(0, 200));
    return [];
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('LLM translation failed:', e);
    return [];
  }
}

async function getRelevantTags(userInput, translatedKeywords) {
  const input = userInput.toLowerCase();
  const relevantTags = new Map();
  const relevantCats = new Set();
  const matchedKeywords = new Set(); // track which translated keywords matched

  // === 主力：LLM 翻译的英文关键词匹配 ===
  // 将翻译出的关键词按词根拆分，与 keywordIndex 做模糊匹配
  if (translatedKeywords && translatedKeywords.length > 0) {
    for (const [cat, keywords] of Object.entries(keywordIndex)) {
      for (const tagName of keywords) {
        const tagLower = tagName.toLowerCase();
        const tagParts = tagLower.split(/[_\s]+/); // 拆分下划线和空格
        for (const tk of translatedKeywords) {
          const tkLower = tk.toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, ' ');
          // 1. 完整匹配
          if (tagLower === tkLower || tagLower === tk.toLowerCase()) {
            relevantCats.add(cat);
            matchedKeywords.add(tk);
          }
          // 2. 包含匹配（关键词是标签的一部分）
          else if (tagLower.includes(tkLower) || tkLower.includes(tagLower)) {
            relevantCats.add(cat);
            matchedKeywords.add(tk);
          }
          // 3. 词根匹配（关键词的某个词根出现在标签中）
          else {
            const tkRoots = tkLower.split(/[_\s]+/).filter(r => r.length > 2);
            for (const root of tkRoots) {
              if (tagParts.some(p => p.includes(root) || root.includes(p))) {
                relevantCats.add(cat);
                matchedKeywords.add(tk);
                break;
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // === 兜底 1：zhToEn 字典匹配（覆盖翻译遗漏）===
  for (const [zh, cats] of Object.entries(zhToEn)) {
    if (input.includes(zh)) cats.forEach(c => relevantCats.add(c));
  }

  // === 兜底 2：原始输入直接匹配 keywordIndex（兼容英文输入）===
  for (const [cat, keywords] of Object.entries(keywordIndex)) {
    for (const kw of keywords) {
      if (input.includes(kw.toLowerCase()) || input.includes(kw.replace(/_/g, ' ').toLowerCase())) {
        relevantCats.add(cat);
      }
    }
  }

  // === 兜底 3：如果什么都没匹配到，加载全部类别 ===
  if (relevantCats.size === 0) Object.keys(keywordIndex).forEach(c => relevantCats.add(c));

  // === 始终包含常用类别 ===
  ['clothes', 'body', 'nature', 'lighting', 'composition', 'style', 'accessory', 'pattern', 'material', 'meta', 'hair', 'eyes', 'emotion']
    .forEach(c => relevantCats.add(c));

  // === 收集标签 ===
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const cat of relevantCats) {
    const catTags = keywordIndex[cat] || [];
    for (const tagName of catTags) {
      if (!seen.has(tagName)) {
        seen.add(tagName);
        const tag = tagMap.get(tagName.toLowerCase());
        if (tag) relevantTags.set(tagName, tag);
      }
    }
  }
  const result = Array.from(relevantTags.values());
  result.sort((a, b) => b.post_count - a.post_count);
  return result.slice(0, 300);
}

// === 内容安全：违规检测（关键词预筛 + LLM 精判） ===

// 敏感关键词库（命中后触发 LLM 精判，不直接拦截）
const SENSITIVE_WORDS = [
  // 色情类
  '露点','性交','性爱','做爱','操逼','鸡巴','屌','奶子','乳房','乳交',
  '肛交','口交','阴部','阴道','阴茎','射精','高潮','裸体','全裸',
  '淫荡','淫乱','乱伦','强奸','猥亵','嫖娼','卖淫','三级片',
  'AV','a片','小电影','毛片','黄片','成人片','色情片',
  '骚','骚货','骚逼',
  // 排泄类
  '屎','尿','屁','屎尿屁',
  // 暴力类
  '杀人','屠杀','砍头','斩首','分尸','凌迟','虐待','折磨',
  '血腥','血腥场面','血腥暴力','尸体','尸块',
  // 毒品类
  '冰毒','海洛因','可卡因','大麻','摇头丸','K粉',
  '制毒','贩毒','吸毒','毒品','嗑药','溜冰',
  // 违法类
  '自杀','自残','自焚','割腕','上吊','跳楼',
  '爆炸物','炸弹','炸药','枪支','弹药',
];

function keywordPreCheck(input) {
  const lower = input.toLowerCase();
  const hit = SENSITIVE_WORDS.filter(w => lower.includes(w));
  return hit.length > 0 ? hit : null;
}

async function checkViolation(input) {
  const preCheck = keywordPreCheck(input);
  
  // 预筛未命中 → 跳过 LLM 检测，放行（正常创作描述不调用 LLM）
  if (!preCheck) {
    return { is_violation: false, type: 'normal', reason: '' };
  }

  // 预筛命中 → LLM 精判
  const prompt = `你是内容审核员，负责判断用户输入是否包含违规内容。

输入内容："${input.replace(/["\\]/g, '').substring(0, 300)}"

检测到的敏感关键词：${preCheck.join('、')}

请结合上下文判断：
- 如果用户是在描述正常的美术/设计/角色创作，即使包含敏感词，也应判定为 normal（例如"红色长裙露背设计"中的"露背"是服装设计）
- 如果用户描述的是明确的色情/暴力/毒品/违法场景，判定为违规
- 模糊地带：判定为 violation，宁可误报不要漏报

违规类型：
- porn（色情）：露骨的性行为描述、生殖器描写、儿童色情
- violence（暴力）：血腥、虐待、屠杀、自残自杀指导
- drugs（毒品）：制毒贩毒吸毒指导、毒品获取方式
- illegal（违法）：武器制作、爆炸物制作、违法活动指导
- harassment（骚扰）：人身攻击、威胁、仇恨言论
- normal（正常）：无违规或正常的艺术/创作描述

返回纯 JSON：{"is_violation":false,"type":"normal","reason":""}
reason 字段必须说明判定理由（一句话）。`;

  try {
    const r = await fetch(CHAT_PROXY_URL, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model: MODEL,
        messages: [{ role: 'system', content: '你是内容审核员，只返回 JSON 对象' }, { role: 'user', content: prompt }],
        max_tokens: 128, temperature: 0.1,
        user_input: input, nickname: currentUser?.nickname, avatar: currentUser?.avatar, skip_log: true
      }),
      credentials: 'include',
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000)
    });
    const d = await r.json();
    const raw = d.choices?.[0]?.message.content || '{}';
    const m = raw.match(/```(?:json)?\s*(\{[\s\S]*?\})\s*```/);
    const result = JSON.parse(m ? m[1] : raw);
    return result;
  } catch { return { is_violation: false, type: 'normal', reason: '检测超时/失败' }; }
}

// 向后端报备违规
async function reportViolation(violation, input) {
  try {
    await fetch(PORTAL_URL + '/api/report', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify({
        nickname: currentUser?.nickname || 'anonymous',
        avatar: currentUser?.avatar || '',
        user_input: input.substring(0, 500),
        violation_type: violation.type,
        violation_reason: violation.reason,
        severity: 'medium'
      }),
      credentials: 'include',
    });
  } catch {}
}

async function searchTags() {
  const input = document.getElementById('userInput').value.trim();
  if (!input) { showToast('请先输入描述'); return; }

  const searchStartTime = Date.now();

  // === 内容安全检查 ===
  document.getElementById('loadingText').textContent = '安全检查中...';
  const violationResult = await checkViolation(input);
  if (violationResult.is_violation) {
    await reportViolation(violationResult, input);
    showToast('输入包含不当内容，已记录');
    document.getElementById('results').classList.remove('active');
    return;
  }

  // 彩蛋：输入特定名字固定回复
  const secretNames = ['安诺涅','安诺涅弥思','涅涅','安安','安诺捏','安佬','营长','小眼睛','楼长','安弥思','佚名','anonymous','匿名者'];
  if (secretNames.some(n => input.toLowerCase().includes(n.toLowerCase()))) {
    displayResults([{ name: 'GXWOQK', zh: '安诺涅温柔地看着你，不再言语', source: 'llm_translated', reason: '彩蛋' }]);
    return;
  }

  const btn = document.getElementById('searchBtn');
  const loading = document.getElementById('loading');
  const results = document.getElementById('results');

  // 根据输入长度决定返回标签数量
  const countRange = getTagCountRange(input);

  // 检查是否为大分类关键词 → 开启分类浏览
  const matchedCat = matchCategory(input);
  if (matchedCat) {
    btn.disabled = false;
    showCategoryBrowser(matchedCat.zh, matchedCat.key, matchedCat.filter);
    return;
  }
  // 分类浏览已激活时，先关闭
  hideCategoryBrowser();

  btn.disabled = true; loading.classList.add('active'); results.classList.remove('active');

  // Trigger lazy loading of copyright/character if not yet loaded
  // Start loading in background, don't block — they'll be available for next search
  if (!copyrightLoaded || !characterLoaded) loadOptionalTags();

  // === 概念语义检测（先于翻译执行）===
  let matchedConcept = null;
  for (const [concept, semantics] of Object.entries(conceptSemantics)) {
    if (input.includes(concept)) {
      matchedConcept = { name: concept, ...semantics };
      break;
    }
  }
  if (matchedConcept) {
    document.getElementById('loadingText').textContent = `检测到概念「${matchedConcept.name}」，正在融合翻译...`;
  }

  // 步骤 1: LLM 翻译中文 → Danbooru 英文关键词（融合概念氛围）
  const translateResult = await translateToDanbooru(input, matchedConcept);
  const translatedKeywords = translateResult.tags || [];
  document.getElementById('loadingText').textContent = matchedConcept
    ? `概念「${matchedConcept.name}」已识别，正在从词库中匹配...`
    : `已识别 ${translatedKeywords.length} 个关键词，正在搜索词库...`;

  const relevantTags = await getRelevantTags(input, translatedKeywords);
  const tagList = relevantTags.map(t => `${t.name} (${t.zh || ''}) [${t.category}]`).join('\n');

  const analyzePrompt = `分析用户描述，判断主要需要什么类型的 Danbooru 标签。
用户描述："${input}"
返回 JSON：{"primary_type":"object/character/scene/action/style","secondary_types":["..."],"should_add_quality_tags":bool,"should_add_generic_tags":bool,"style_keywords":["整体风格/氛围关键词，不是具体物体标签"]}
不要列举具体物体标签，只判断类型和整体风格。`;

  let intent = { primary_type:'object', secondary_types:[], style_keywords:[], should_add_quality_tags:false, should_add_generic_tags:false };
  try {
    const r = await fetch(CHAT_PROXY_URL, { method:'POST', headers: getAuthHeaders(), body:JSON.stringify({ model:MODEL, messages:[{role:'system',content:'只返回JSON'},{role:'user',content:analyzePrompt}], max_tokens:256, temperature:0.1, user_input: document.getElementById('userInput').value, nickname: currentUser?.nickname, avatar: currentUser?.avatar, skip_log: true }), credentials: 'include' });
    const d = await r.json(); const c = d.choices[0].message.content;
    const m = c.match(/```(?:json)?\s*(\{[\s\S]*?\})\s*```/);
    intent = JSON.parse(m ? m[1] : c);
  } catch(e) {}

  // 构建 adjective_combos 参考文本
  let comboRefText = '';
  try {
    const comboSections = ['texture', 'lighting', 'style', 'weather', 'time'];
    for (const section of comboSections) {
      if (adjectiveCombos[section]) {
        comboRefText += `\n**${section}维度：** ${Object.entries(adjectiveCombos[section]).map(([k, v]) => `"${k}"→${v.slice(0, 3).join(', ')}`).join('；')}`;
      }
    }
  } catch(e) {}

  const matchPrompt = `${LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT}

用户描述："${input}"
${matchedConcept ? `=== 概念语义线索 ===
概念词：「${matchedConcept.name}」| 英文：${matchedConcept.en}
氛围关键词：${matchedConcept.vibe} | 详细线索：${matchedConcept.hints}
建议标签：${matchedConcept.related_tags.join(', ')}
概念是整体风格指引，不是具体视觉元素，要选出能表达这种"感觉"的标签。
` : ''}意图分析：用户主要想要 ${intent.primary_type} 类型标签
用户原始输入：${input}
${intent.should_add_quality_tags ? '可添加质量标签' : '不要添加质量标签'}
${intent.should_add_generic_tags ? '可添加构图标签' : '不要添加无关的构图/背景/姿势标签，除非用户明确提到'}
风格关键词：${intent.style_keywords ? intent.style_keywords.join(', ') : '无'}

词库参考：
${tagList}

=== 📋 拆解视觉元素 ===

逐个拆解用户描述中的每个视觉元素，对每个元素推导 3-6 个 Danbooru 标签。
示例："彩虹拟人，小蛋糕元素"
→ 元素1：彩虹（颜色/光谱/折射）→ prism, iridescent_skin, rainbow_gradient, refraction, multicolored_hair, crystal
→ 元素2：拟人（非人→人形）→ anthropomorphic + 该生物的具体特征
→ 元素3：小蛋糕（甜点/装饰）→ frosting, sprinkles, whipped_cream, cherry, cupcake, pastel_sweets

**关键：从你的标签应该能反推出用户的原始描述。如果做不到，说明标签太泛泛了。**

=== 🧠 深度翻译 ===

不要照搬字面意思！要像画师构思画面那样推导：
- "蚊子拟人" → 不只是 mosquito + anthropomorphic，而是 proboscis, translucent_wings, thin_limbs, compound_eyes, chelicerae
- "梦核，白色连衣裙" → 不只是 dreamcore + white_dress，而是 liminal_space, faded_white_dress, uncanny_aesthetic, pastel_palette

意象群参考：
- "彩虹" → prism, iridescent, rainbow_gradient, colorful, multicolored, refraction, crystal
- "蛋糕甜点" → frosting, sprinkles, whipped_cream, cherry, pastel, sweet
- "火焰" → embers, smoke, ash, heat_haze, warm_lighting, burning
- "冰雪" → snowflake, frost, ice_crystal, cold_lighting, translucent, frozen
- "海洋" → wave, sea_foam, coral, pearl, translucent, wet
- "花" → petals, pollen, flower_ornament, floral_print, bloom
- "月亮" → crescent, moonlight, lunar_glow, night_sky, pale
- "机械" → gears, mechanical_parts, metallic, cyborg, circuit

=== 🔗 组合词推导 ===

推导公式：{修饰词} + {基础元素} = 组合标签
修饰词：silk, leather, lace, flame, ice, lightning, smoke, crystal, glowing, iridescent, broken, cracked, melting, burning, gothic, tribal, red, blue, silver, gold...
基础元素：dress, coat, hair, eyes, wings, tail, halo, crown, markings, aura, petals...
组合示例：
- "燃烧的衣摆" → burning_clothes, flame_trim, flame_print
- "液态光环" → glowing_halo, wet, translucent
- "碎裂的水晶瞳孔" → crystal_eyes, gemstone_eyes, cracked_skin
${comboRefText}
组合原则：贴合主题才用，不为了组合而组合。描述丰富时至少尝试 3-5 个组合标签。

=== 👤 人外/异头角色推导 ===

不要只给"兽耳+尾巴"！每个生物有最独特的 2-3 个视觉符号：
- 蜘蛛 → 螯肢(chelicerae)/纺丝器(spinneret)/复眼(compound_eyes)/外骨骼(exoskeleton)
- 鸟 → 鸟喙(beak)/头翼(head_wings)/羽毛翅膀(feathered_wings)
- 蛇 → 分叉舌(forked_tongue)/竖瞳(slit_pupils)/鳞片(scales)
- 海洋 → 鳍(fins)/鳃(gills)/半透明皮肤(translucent_skin)
异头：头部是什么就用 {animal}_head 或具体物体名。人形身体+动物头 → anthropomorphic。

=== ✨ OC 辨识度 ===

从以下维度挑选 3-6 个有辨识度的标签：
- 特殊瞳孔（竖瞳/星形/花形/空心/渐变/发光）比"蓝眼"更有辨识度
- 面部标记（形状标记/面部缝合/异色瞳）比"漂亮脸蛋"更有记忆点
- 非人特征（头翼/多肢/复眼/外骨骼/鳞片/触手）让人物跳出人类框架
- 配饰（锁链/镣铐/眼罩/光环/项圈）暗示角色背景
推导方法：不要直接给基础标签，试着组合修饰词+基础元素。

=== ✅ 关注维度 ===

当用户输入涉及角色/拟人/概念时，按以下维度拆解：
1. 外观特征：发型发色、眼睛颜色形状、特殊身体特征（角/尾巴/翅膀等）
2. 服装设计：类型、袖型、领型、长度、剪裁
3. 服装细节：材质、装饰、图案
4. 配色方案：主题色系、渐变、对比色
5. 配饰道具：头饰、首饰、武器、手持物品
6. 光影氛围：光影类型、色调、特效
7. 概念元素：从生物解剖、习性、环境推导核心视觉符号

=== 输出规则 ===

1. 将用户中文描述拆解为具体视觉元素
2. 拟人/概念角色先拆解核心视觉符号再转化为标签
3. 人外/异头角色：找到最独特的 2-3 个视觉符号
4. 有主题时可运用组合词，贴合角色时才用
5. 从词库参考中匹配已有标签（source: database），没有的合理生成（source: llm_translated）
6. 绝对不输出禁止标签
7. 返回 ${countRange.min}-${countRange.max} 个最匹配标签，包括直接提到的元素和联想到的相关意象，每个都要有辨识度
8. 严格按 JSON 格式返回
9. **每个 llm_translated 标签必须出现在某个 decomposition 元素的 derived_tags 中，不允许凭空生成**
10. **标签要能反推用户原始描述**

返回 JSON 格式：
{
  "decomposition": [
    {"element": "用户描述中的视觉元素", "derived_tags": ["具体标签1", "具体标签2", "具体标签3"]}
  ],
  "tags": [
    {"name":"标签名","zh":"中文翻译","source":"database/llm_translated","reason":"为什么选这个标签，对应哪个视觉元素"}
  ],
  "explanation":"一句话总结画面感"
}

decomposition 字段：逐个拆解每个视觉元素，对每个元素列出 3-6 个候选标签。
tags 字段：从所有 derived_tags 中挑选最有辨识度的 ${countRange.min}-${countRange.max} 个，每个必须能追溯到具体元素。
reason 字段：要具体，说明对应哪个视觉元素，不能写"很贴合主题"这种空话。`;

  const loadingTexts = ['正在理解描述...', '正在翻译为 Danbooru 关键词...', '正在搜索词库...', '正在匹配标签...', '即将完成...'];
  let ti = 0;
  const tInterval = setInterval(() => { ti = (ti + 1) % loadingTexts.length; document.getElementById('loadingText').textContent = loadingTexts[ti]; }, 1500);

  // 自动重试：502/503 时自动再试一次，延长等待时间
  const MAX_SEARCH_RETRIES = 3; // 最多 3 次尝试
  const SEARCH_TIMEOUT = 120000; // 每次请求等待 120 秒
  let searchAttempt = 0;
  let response, data;

  while (searchAttempt < MAX_SEARCH_RETRIES) {
    searchAttempt++;
    try {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), SEARCH_TIMEOUT);

      response = await fetch(CHAT_PROXY_URL, {
        method: 'POST', headers: getAuthHeaders(),
        body: JSON.stringify({ model: MODEL, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: '只返回 JSON' }, { role: 'user', content: matchPrompt }], max_tokens: 4096, temperature: 0.5, user_input: input, nickname: currentUser?.nickname, avatar: currentUser?.avatar }),
        credentials: 'include',
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      clearTimeout(timer);
      clearInterval(tInterval);
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('API 错误: ' + response.status);
      data = await response.json();
      break; // 成功，跳出重试循环
    } catch (e) {
      if (searchAttempt >= MAX_SEARCH_RETRIES) throw e; // 重试耗尽，抛出
      // 502/503/超时 自动重试
      const isRetryable = e.message.includes('502') || e.message.includes('503') || e.name === 'AbortError';
      if (!isRetryable) throw e; // 非 50x/超时错误，不重试
      console.log(`[Search] Attempt ${searchAttempt} failed (${e.name || e.message}), retrying...`);
      document.getElementById('loadingText').textContent = `请求延迟，正在重试 (${searchAttempt}/${MAX_SEARCH_RETRIES})...`;
    }
  }

  try {
    const content = data.choices[0].message.content;
    let result;
    try { const jm = content.match(/```(?:json)?\s*(\{[\s\S]*?\})\s*```/); result = jm ? JSON.parse(jm[1]) : JSON.parse(content); }
    catch (e) { showToast('你莫不是在消遣洒家'); return; }

    // 后处理：过滤禁止标签（使用统一常量）
    let tags = (result.tags || []).filter(t => !FORBIDDEN_TAGS.has(t.name.toLowerCase()));
    if (result.decomposition && result.decomposition.length > 0) {
      const coveredElements = new Set(tags.map(t => t.name.toLowerCase()));
      for (const de of result.decomposition) {
        const hasCoverage = de.derived_tags.some(dt => coveredElements.has(dt.toLowerCase()));
        if (!hasCoverage && de.derived_tags.length > 0) {
          for (const dt of de.derived_tags.slice(0, 2)) {
            if (!coveredElements.has(dt.toLowerCase()) && !FORBIDDEN_TAGS.has(dt.toLowerCase())) {
              tags.push({ name: dt, zh: '', source: 'llm_translated', reason: de.element + ' 的衍生标签' });
              coveredElements.add(dt.toLowerCase());
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    displayResults(tags);

    // 上报查询日志（后台异步，不阻塞显示）
    reportLog(input, tags.length, Date.now() - searchStartTime, tags);

    // 运行智能诊断（后台异步，不阻塞显示）
    runDiagnostics(input, tags);
  } catch (e) { showToast('搜索失败：' + e.message); }
  finally { clearInterval(tInterval); btn.disabled = false; loading.classList.remove('active'); }
}

function displayResults(tags) {
  const grid = document.getElementById('tagsGrid');
  const results = document.getElementById('results');
  const resultCount = document.getElementById('resultCount');
  grid.innerHTML = ''; selectedTags.clear(); updateSelectedBar();
  if (!tags.length) { showToast('没有匹配结果'); return; }
  resultCount.textContent = `(${tags.length} 个)`;
  tags.forEach(tag => {
    const dbTag = tagMap.get(tag.name.toLowerCase());
    const card = document.createElement('div'); card.className = 'tag-card'; card.dataset.name = tag.name;
    const source = tag.source === 'llm_translated' ? 'llm_generated' : (dbTag ? dbTag.category : 'general');
    card.dataset.category = source;
    const isCombo = tag.source === 'llm_translated' && tag.name.includes('_') && /flame|ice|lightning|smoke|shadow|blood|water|liquid|petal|crystal|thorn|vine|web|burning|glowing|shimmering|iridescent|broken|cracked|melting|twisted|tangled|flowing|dripping|silk|leather|lace|latex|metal|bone|chain|feather|fur|gothic|baroque|tribal/.test(tag.name.split('_')[0]);
    const badge = tag.source === 'llm_translated' ? `<div class="tag-source">AI 翻译${isCombo ? ' · 🔗 组合推导' : ''}</div>` : '';
    const count = dbTag ? formatNumber(dbTag.post_count) + ' posts' : '新标签';
    card.innerHTML = `<div class="tag-name">${tag.name.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</div>${badge}<div class="tag-zh">${tag.zh || ''}</div><div class="tag-meta"><span class="tag-category ${source}">${source === 'llm_generated' ? 'AI 翻译' : source}</span><span class="tag-posts">${count}</span></div>`;
    card.onclick = () => toggleTag(card, tag.name);
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
  results.classList.add('active');
}

// === 上报查询日志到后端 ===
async function reportLog(input, resultCount, duration, tags) {
  try {
    // 提取标签名（轻量，不传完整对象）
    const tagNames = Array.isArray(tags) ? tags.slice(0, 20).map(t => t.name || t).filter(Boolean) : [];
    const endpoints = [API_BASE + '/api/log'];
    for (const endpoint of endpoints) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: getAuthHeaders(),
          body: JSON.stringify({
            user: currentUser?.nickname || currentUser?.user_id || 'anonymous',
            input,
            result_count: resultCount,
            duration_ms: Math.round(duration),
            cached: false,
            model: MODEL,
            tags: tagNames,
          }),
          credentials: 'include',
        });
        if (res.ok) return;
      } catch { /* 端点不可用，尝试下一个 */ }
    }
  } catch { /* 上报失败不阻塞用户 */ }
}

function toggleTag(card, name) {
  if (selectedTags.has(name)) { selectedTags.delete(name); card.classList.remove('selected'); }
  else { selectedTags.add(name); card.classList.add('selected'); }
  updateSelectedBar();
}
function updateSelectedBar() {
  const bar = document.getElementById('selectedBar');
  const container = document.getElementById('selectedTags');
  const count = document.getElementById('selectedCount');
  if (!selectedTags.size) { bar.classList.remove('active'); return; }
  bar.classList.add('active'); count.textContent = `已选 ${selectedTags.size} 个`;
  container.innerHTML = '';
  selectedTags.forEach(t => {
    const el = document.createElement('span'); el.className = 'selected-tag';
    el.innerHTML = `${t} <span class="remove-tag" onclick="removeTag('${t}')">×</span>`;
    container.appendChild(el);
  });
}
function removeTag(name) {
  selectedTags.delete(name);
  const card = document.querySelector(`.tag-card[data-name="${name}"]`);
  if (card) card.classList.remove('selected');
  updateSelectedBar();
}
function copyAllTags() { copyToClipboard(Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.tag-card')).map(c => c.dataset.name).join(', ')); }
function copySelectedTags() { if (!selectedTags.size) { showToast('请先选择'); return; } copyToClipboard(Array.from(selectedTags).join(', ')); }
function copyToClipboard(text) {
  if (!text) { showToast('没有可复制的内容'); return; }
  // 主力方案: textarea + execCommand（兼容性好，不依赖 Clipboard API 权限）
  const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
  ta.value = text;
  ta.setAttribute('readonly', '');
  ta.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:1px;height:1px;opacity:0;';
  document.body.appendChild(ta);
  ta.focus();
  ta.select();
  ta.setSelectionRange(0, 99999);
  let ok = false;
  try { ok = document.execCommand('copy'); } catch(e) {}
  document.body.removeChild(ta);
  if (ok) {
    showToast('已复制 ' + text.split(',').length + ' 个标签');
  } else {
    // 备用方案: Clipboard API
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(
        () => showToast('已复制 ' + text.split(',').length + ' 个标签'),
        () => prompt('请手动复制（Ctrl+C）：', text)
      );
    } else {
      prompt('请手动复制（Ctrl+C）：', text);
    }
  }
}
function showToast(msg) { const t = document.getElementById('toast'); t.textContent = msg; t.classList.add('active'); setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('active'), 3000); }
function formatNumber(n) { if (n >= 1e6) return (n/1e6).toFixed(1)+'M'; if (n >= 1e3) return (n/1e3).toFixed(1)+'K'; return n.toString(); }

function toggleRefPanel() {
  const content = document.getElementById('refContent');
  const arrow = document.getElementById('refArrow');
  if (content.style.display === 'none') {
    content.style.display = 'block';
    arrow.classList.add('open');
    if (!content.dataset.loaded) {
      renderRefCategories();
      content.dataset.loaded = 'true';
    }
  } else {
    content.style.display = 'none';
    arrow.classList.remove('open');
  }
}

function renderRefCategories() {
  const container = document.getElementById('refCategories');
  let html = '<div class="ref-categories">';
  let idx = 0;
  for (const [groupName, tags] of Object.entries(refCategories)) {
    html += `
      <div class="ref-category-item" onclick="toggleRefCategory(${idx})">
        <span>${groupName} <span style="color:var(--text-light);font-size:0.8rem">(${tags.length})</span></span>
        <span class="cat-arrow" id="catArrow${idx}">▶</span>
      </div>
      <div class="ref-tags-wrapper" id="catTags${idx}">
        <div class="ref-tag-list">`;
    for (const [en, zh] of tags) {
      html += `<span class="ref-tag" onclick="event.stopPropagation();addRefTag('${en}')">${en}<span class="ref-zh">${zh}</span></span>`;
    }
    html += '</div></div>';
    idx++;
  }
  html += '</div>';
  container.innerHTML = html;
}

function toggleRefCategory(idx) {
  const wrapper = document.getElementById('catTags' + idx);
  const arrow = document.getElementById('catArrow' + idx);
  if (wrapper.classList.contains('open')) {
    wrapper.classList.remove('open');
    arrow.classList.remove('open');
  } else {
    wrapper.classList.add('open');
    arrow.classList.add('open');
  }
}

function addRefTag(tagName) {
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(tagName).then(() => {
    showToast('已复制: ' + tagName);
  }).catch(() => {
    // fallback
    const t = document.createElement('textarea');
    t.value = tagName;
    document.body.appendChild(t);
    t.select();
    document.execCommand('copy');
    document.body.removeChild(t);
    showToast('已复制: ' + tagName);
  });
}

// === 分类浏览：keywordIndex + 分段 LLM 分组 ===
const CHUNK_SIZE = 180;
const MAX_CONCURRENCY = 3;

// 具体物品 → 所属大类 + 过滤关键词（用于在 browseCategory 中缩小范围）

  '上衣': { key: 'clothes', filter: 'shirt|blouse|top|tunic|t-shirt|tank_top|camisole|crop_top|jersey|sweater|hoodie|cardigan|coat|jacket|blazer|vest|poncho|cape|turtleneck|polo_shirt|gym_shirt|sailor_shirt|cowl_neck|off-shoulder|halterneck|tube_top' },

  '制服': { key: 'clothes', filter: 'uniform|school_uniform|military|military_uniform|serafuku|gym_uniform|office_lady|sailor|naval|maid|mekakure|police|nurse|cheerleader|cheerios|space_suit|labcoat' },

function matchCategory(input) {
  const trimmed = input.trim();
  const isSimple = trimmed.length <= 3;

  // 精确匹配（最高优先级）：输入完全等于某个分类词
  if (itemToFilter[trimmed]) {
    const info = itemToFilter[trimmed];
    return { zh: trimmed, key: info.key, filter: info.filter };
  }
  if (catToKey[trimmed]) {
    return { zh: trimmed, key: catToKey[trimmed] };
  }

  // 只有简短输入（≤3 字）才允许模糊包含
  // 比如"头发""服装""眼睛"等大类词 → 出子分类浏览
  // "红色长发""白色连衣裙"等具体描述 → 不走分类，直接 LLM 翻译
  if (isSimple) {
    // 优先匹配具体物品（有 filter 的条目）
    for (const [zh, info] of Object.entries(itemToFilter)) {
      if (trimmed.includes(zh)) return { zh, key: info.key, filter: info.filter };
    }
    // 兜底：匹配大类
    for (const [zh, key] of Object.entries(catToKey)) {
      if (trimmed.includes(zh) && !itemToFilter[zh]) return { zh, key };
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function showCategoryBrowser(catZh, catKey, filterRegex) {
  document.getElementById('categoryBrowser').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('results').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('loading').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('catHint').textContent = `正在加载 ${catZh} 分类...`;
  const existing = document.querySelector('.adjective-section');
  if (existing) existing.remove();
  browseCategory(catZh, catKey, filterRegex);
}

function hideCategoryBrowser() {
  document.getElementById('categoryBrowser').classList.remove('active');
}

// 按 post_count 降序后切块
function chunkTags(tags, size) {
  const sorted = [...tags].sort((a, b) => b.post_count - a.post_count);
  const chunks = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i += size) {
    chunks.push(sorted.slice(i, i + size));
  }
  return chunks;
}

// 并发控制：最多 limit 个同时跑
async function runWithConcurrency(tasks, limit) {
  const results = [];
  const executing = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < tasks.length; i++) {
    const p = tasks[i]().then(r => { results[i] = r; return r; });
    executing.push(p);
    if (executing.length >= limit) {
      await Promise.race(executing);
      executing.splice(executing.findIndex(q => q === executing.find(x => x === p)), 1);
    }
  }
  await Promise.all(executing);
  return results.filter(r => r !== undefined);
}

// 单个分段的 LLM 分组请求
async function groupChunk(chunk, catLabel) {
  const tagNames = chunk.map(t => t.name);
  const prompt = `将以下 Danbooru 标签按语义分为 5-8 个中文命名的子组，返回 JSON 对象 {"子组名": ["tag1","tag2",...]}。
分组要合理，按类型、风格、用途等分类。只返回 JSON。
标签：${tagNames.join(', ')}`;
  const r = await fetch(CHAT_PROXY_URL, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: getAuthHeaders(),
    body: JSON.stringify({ model: MODEL, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: '只返回 JSON 对象' }, { role: 'user', content: prompt }], max_tokens: 2048, temperature: 0.1, user_input: '', nickname: currentUser?.nickname, avatar: currentUser?.avatar, skip_log: true }),
    credentials: 'include',
  });
  const d = await r.json();
  const c = d.choices[0].message.content;
  const m = c.match(/```(?:json)?\s*(\{[\s\S]*?\})\s*```/);
  return JSON.parse(m ? m[1] : c);
}

// 合并分组结果：相同组名合并标签
function mergeGroups(groupList) {
  const merged = {};
  for (const groups of groupList) {
    for (const [name, tags] of Object.entries(groups)) {
      if (!merged[name]) merged[name] = [];
      merged[name].push(...tags);
    }
  }
  // 去重
  for (const k of Object.keys(merged)) {
    merged[k] = [...new Set(merged[k])];
  }
  return merged;
}

// 主入口：取标签 → 过滤 → 切块 → 并发分组 → 渲染
async function browseCategory(catLabel, catKey, filterRegex) {
  const keyTags = keywordIndex[catKey];
  if (!keyTags) {
    document.getElementById('catHint').textContent = '未找到该分类的数据';
    return;
  }

  const catTags = keyTags.map(n => tagMap.get(n.toLowerCase())).filter(Boolean);

  // 如果有 filterRegex，先按正则过滤标签
  let filtered = catTags;
  let filterInfo = '';
  if (filterRegex) {
    const re = new RegExp(filterRegex, 'i');
    filtered = catTags.filter(t => re.test(t.name));
    filterInfo = `（过滤词: ${filterRegex}）`;
  }

  filtered = filterColorVariants(filtered);

  // 大分类：只取前 500 个高热度标签
  const displayTags = filtered.length > 600 ? filtered.slice(0, 500) : filtered;

  // 检查 sessionStorage 缓存（含 filter 信息）
  const cacheKey = `dtag_group_${catKey}_${filterRegex || 'all'}`;
  const cached = sessionStorage.getItem(cacheKey);
  if (cached) {
    const groups = JSON.parse(cached);
    renderCategoryGroups(groups, catLabel, displayTags);
    return;
  }

  // 不超过 CHUNK_SIZE → 直接展示英文名，不批量翻译
  if (displayTags.length <= CHUNK_SIZE) {
    document.getElementById('catHint').textContent = `${catLabel}：${displayTags.length} 个标签${filterInfo}`;
    displayRawTags(displayTags);
    return;
  }

  // 切块 + 并发 LLM 分组
  const chunks = chunkTags(displayTags, CHUNK_SIZE);
  document.getElementById('catHint').textContent = `${catLabel}：${displayTags.length} 个标签${filterInfo}，分 ${chunks.length} 组处理中...`;

  const tasks = chunks.map(chunk => () => groupChunk(chunk, catLabel).catch(e => {
    console.warn('LLM 分组失败:', e);
    return null;
  }));

  const groupResults = (await runWithConcurrency(tasks, MAX_CONCURRENCY)).filter(Boolean);

  if (groupResults.length > 0) {
    const merged = mergeGroups(groupResults);
    // 缓存结果
    try { sessionStorage.setItem(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(merged)); } catch(e) {}
    renderCategoryGroups(merged, catLabel, displayTags);
  } else {
    // LLM 全部失败 → 直接展示英文名
    document.getElementById('catHint').textContent = `${catLabel}：${displayTags.length} 个标签${filterInfo}（分组失败，直接展示）`;
    displayRawTags(displayTags);
  }
}

// 渲染分组卡片
function renderCategoryGroups(groups, catLabel, allTags) {
  const grid = document.getElementById('subcatGrid');
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  const tagsByName = new Map(allTags.map(t => [t.name, t]));

  for (const [groupName, groupTags] of Object.entries(groups)) {
    const matched = filterColorVariants(groupTags.map(t => tagsByName.get(t)).filter(Boolean));
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'subcat-card';
    card.innerHTML = `<div class="subcat-name">${groupName}</div><div class="subcat-count">${matched.length} 个标签</div>`;
    card.onclick = () => {
      document.getElementById('catHint').textContent = `${groupName} — 点击返回`;
      // 添加返回按钮
      grid.innerHTML = '';
      const backBtn = document.createElement('div');
      backBtn.className = 'subcat-card';
      backBtn.innerHTML = `<div class="subcat-name">← 返回 ${catLabel} 分组</div>`;
      backBtn.onclick = () => renderCategoryGroups(groups, catLabel, allTags);
      grid.appendChild(backBtn);
      translateAndDisplay(matched);
    };
    grid.appendChild(card);
  }
  document.getElementById('catHint').textContent = `${catLabel}：已分为 ${Object.keys(groups).length} 个子组`;
}

// 仅展示英文标签名，不触发 LLM 翻译
function displayRawTags(tags) {

  const tagsGrid = document.getElementById('tagsGrid');
  results.classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('resultCount').textContent = `(${tags.length} 个)`;
  tagsGrid.innerHTML = '';
