    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'tag-card';
    card.dataset.name = tag.name;
    card.dataset.category = tag.category;
    const count = tag.post_count ? formatNumber(tag.post_count) + ' posts' : '新标签';
    card.innerHTML = `<div class="tag-name">${tag.name.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</div><div class="tag-zh"></div><div class="tag-meta"><span class="tag-category ${tag.category}">${tag.category}</span><span class="tag-posts">${count}</span></div>`;
    card.onclick = () => toggleTag(card, tag.name);
    tagsGrid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

// 翻译并展示标签 — 先渲染卡片，再逐条翻译填充中文
async function translateAndDisplay(sorted) {
  sorted = filterColorVariants(sorted);

  // 先从缓存里填充已知翻译
  for (const t of sorted) {
    if (llmZhCache.has(t.name)) {
      t.zh = llmZhCache.get(t.name);
    }
  }

  // 先渲染所有卡片（已有缓存翻译的直接显示中文）
  const results = document.getElementById('results');
  const tagsGrid = document.getElementById('tagsGrid');
  results.classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('resultCount').textContent = `(${sorted.length} 个)`;
  tagsGrid.innerHTML = '';
  selectedTags.clear();
  updateSelectedBar();

  // 构建卡片
  const cardMap = new Map();
  sorted.forEach(tag => {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'tag-card';
    card.dataset.name = tag.name;
    card.dataset.category = tag.category;
    const count = tag.post_count ? formatNumber(tag.post_count) + ' posts' : '新标签';
    card.innerHTML = `<div class="tag-name">${tag.name.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</div><div class="tag-zh">${tag.zh || ''}</div><div class="tag-meta"><span class="tag-category ${tag.category}">${tag.category}</span><span class="tag-posts">${count}</span></div>`;
    card.onclick = () => toggleTag(card, tag.name);
    tagsGrid.appendChild(card);
    cardMap.set(tag.name, card);
  });

  // 收集需要翻译的标签
  const uncached = sorted.filter(t => !t.zh || t.zh === t.name).map(t => t.name);
  if (uncached.length === 0) return;

  // 逐条翻译，翻完立即更新对应卡片的中文
  const hint = document.getElementById('catHint');
  let done = 0;
  for (const tagName of uncached) {
    try {
      const prompt = `翻译为中文，只返回翻译文本，不要引号或其他内容：${tagName}`;
      const r = await fetch(CHAT_PROXY_URL, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: getAuthHeaders(),
        body: JSON.stringify({ model: MODEL, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: '只返回中文翻译文本' }, { role: 'user', content: prompt }], max_tokens: 32, temperature: 0.1, user_input: tagName, nickname: currentUser?.nickname, avatar: currentUser?.avatar, skip_log: true }),
        credentials: 'include',
      });
      const d = await r.json();
      const zh = d.choices[0].message.content.trim();
      llmZhCache.set(tagName, zh);

      // 更新对应卡片的中文翻译
      const card = cardMap.get(tagName);
      if (card) {
        const zhEl = card.querySelector('.tag-zh');
        if (zhEl) zhEl.textContent = zh;
      }
      done++;
      if (hint) hint.textContent = `翻译中 ${done} / ${uncached.length}`;
    } catch(e) {
      console.warn('翻译失败:', tagName, e);
    }
  }
  if (hint) hint.textContent = `翻译完成`;
}

// === 智能诊断与优化引擎 ===
let diagOpen = false;
function toggleDiagPanel() {
  diagOpen = !diagOpen;
  document.getElementById('diagBody').classList.toggle('open', diagOpen);
  document.getElementById('diagArrow').classList.toggle('open', diagOpen);
}

async function runDiagnostics(userInput, currentTags) {
  const panel = document.getElementById('diagPanel');
  const content = document.getElementById('diagContent');
  panel.classList.add('active');
  content.innerHTML = `<div class="diag-loading"><div class="diag-spinner"></div><div>正在分析描述，诊断特色缺失...</div></div>`;

  if (!diagOpen) {
    diagOpen = true;
    document.getElementById('diagBody').classList.add('open');
    document.getElementById('diagArrow').classList.add('open');
  }

  const tagNamesStr = currentTags.slice(0, 40).map(t => t.name).join(', ');
  const safeInput = userInput.replace(/[\\"]/g, '').replace(/\n/g, ' ');

  const diagPrompt = '分析用户描述和已匹配的 Danbooru 标签，诊断特色不足并推荐优化。返回纯 JSON。\n\n输入：' + safeInput + '\n已匹配标签：' + (tagNamesStr || '无') + '\n\n返回格式：{"uniqueness_score":0-100,"pain_points":[{"type":"类型","desc":"中文","detail":"详情"}],"optimization_suggestions":[{"name":"英文标签","zh":"中文","reason":"推荐理由"}],"combo_recommendations":[{"tags":["t1","t2"],"reason":"说明"}],"summary":"一句话总结"}\n\n规则：指出太通用的标签、遗漏的元素、推荐有辨识度的标签和组合。不要推荐万能废词。标签用下划线连接。';

  try {
    const response = await fetch(CHAT_PROXY_URL, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify({ model: MODEL, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: '只返回 JSON' }, { role: 'user', content: diagPrompt }], max_tokens: 2048, temperature: 0.5, user_input: userInput, nickname: currentUser?.nickname, avatar: currentUser?.avatar, skip_log: true }),
      credentials: 'include',
    });
    if (!response.ok) {
      content.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--text-light);">API 错误: ' + response.status + '</p>';
      return;
    }
    const data = await response.json();
    if (!data.choices || !data.choices[0]) {
      content.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--text-light);">返回格式异常</p>';
      return;
    }
    const raw = data.choices[0].message.content;
    let result;
    try {
      const jm = raw.match(/```(?:json)?\s*(\{[\s\S]*?\})\s*```/);
      result = jm ? JSON.parse(jm[1]) : JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch(e) {
      content.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--text-light);">你莫不是在消遣洒家</p>';
      console.error('Diag parse error:', e, 'Raw:', raw.substring(0, 200));
      return;
    }
    renderDiagnostics(result, currentTags);
  } catch(e) {
    content.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--text-light);">分析失败：' + e.message + '</p>';
    console.error('Diag fetch error:', e);
  }
}

function renderDiagnostics(result, currentTags) {
  const content = document.getElementById('diagContent');
  const score = result.uniqueness_score || 50;
  const scoreColor = score >= 70 ? '#4a8b5a' : score >= 40 ? '#b5962a' : '#b54a4a';
  const scoreLabel = score >= 70 ? '辨识度高' : score >= 40 ? '中规中矩' : '过于普通';

  let html = '';

  // 辨识度评分
  html += `<div class="uniqueness-bar">
    <span class="uniqueness-label">辨识度</span>
    <div class="uniqueness-track">
      <div class="uniqueness-fill" style="width:${score}%;background:${scoreColor};"></div>
    </div>
    <span class="uniqueness-value" style="color:${scoreColor}">${score}<small style="font-size:0.7rem;font-weight:400;"> ${scoreLabel}</small></span>
  </div>`;

  // 总结
  if (result.summary) {
    html += `<div class="diag-section">
      <h4><span class="diag-icon">💡</span> 诊断总结</h4>
      <p style="font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--text-mid);line-height:1.6;padding:0.5rem 0;">${result.summary}</p>
    </div>`;
  }

  // 痛点
  if (result.pain_points && result.pain_points.length > 0) {
    html += `<div class="diag-section">
      <h4><span class="diag-icon">🔍</span> 痛点诊断 (${result.pain_points.length})</h4>`;
    for (const pp of result.pain_points) {
      html += `<div class="pain-point">
        <span class="pp-label">${pp.type}</span>
        <div><strong>${pp.desc}</strong><br><span style="color:var(--text-light);font-size:0.85rem;">${pp.detail}</span></div>
      </div>`;
    }
    html += '</div>';
  }

  // 优化建议
  if (result.optimization_suggestions && result.optimization_suggestions.length > 0) {
    html += `<div class="diag-section">
      <h4><span class="diag-icon">✨</span> 特色标签推荐</h4>
      <p class="hint" style="font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--text-light);margin-bottom:0.8rem;font-style:italic;">点击即可添加到选中列表</p>
      <div class="suggestion-grid">`;
    for (const sg of result.optimization_suggestions) {
      html += `<div class="suggestion-card" onclick="addSuggestionTag(this, '${sg.name}', '${sg.zh || ''}')">
        <div class="sg-name">${sg.name.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</div>
        <div class="sg-zh">${sg.zh || ''}</div>
        <div class="sg-reason">${sg.reason}</div>
        <span class="sg-add">+ 添加</span>
      </div>`;
    }
    html += '</div></div>';
  }

  // 组合推荐
  if (result.combo_recommendations && result.combo_recommendations.length > 0) {
    html += `<div class="diag-section">
      <h4><span class="diag-icon">🔗</span> 组合推荐</h4>
      <p class="hint" style="font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--text-light);margin-bottom:0.8rem;font-style:italic;">点击即可将这组标签一起添加到输入框</p>`;
    for (const cr of result.combo_recommendations) {
      const tagsStr = cr.tags.join(', ');
      html += `<div class="combo-suggestion" onclick="addComboTags(this, '${tagsStr.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">
        <div class="cs-badge">🔗 组合</div>
        <div class="cs-tags">${tagsStr.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</div>
        <div class="cs-reason">${cr.reason}</div>
      </div>`;
    }
    html += '</div>';
  }

  // 一键优化按钮
  if (result.optimization_suggestions && result.optimization_suggestions.length > 0) {
    const allNames = result.optimization_suggestions.map(s => s.name).join(', ');
    html += `<div style="text-align:center;margin-top:1.5rem;padding-top:1rem;border-top:1px dotted var(--border-light);">
      <button class="action-btn" onclick="addAllSuggested('${allNames}')" style="font-size:1rem;padding:0.8rem 2rem;">
        ✨ 一键采纳全部建议 (${result.optimization_suggestions.length} 个标签)
      </button>
    </div>`;
  }

  content.innerHTML = html;
}

function addSuggestionTag(card, name, zh) {
  selectedTags.add(name);
  card.classList.add('selected');
  updateSelectedBar();
  // 同时更新搜索结果中的选中状态
  const existingCard = document.querySelector(`.tag-card[data-name="${name}"]`);
  if (existingCard) existingCard.classList.add('selected');
  showToast('已添加: ' + name.replace(/_/g, ' '));
}

function addComboToInput(tagsStr) {
  const inp = document.getElementById('userInput');
  const existing = inp.value.split(/[，,]/).map(s => s.trim());
  for (const tag of tagsStr.split(', ')) {
    if (!inp.value.includes(tag)) {
      existing.push(tag.replace(/_/g, ' '));
    }
  }
  inp.value = existing.join('，');
  inp.focus();
  showToast('已添加到输入框，可重新搜索');
}

function addComboTags(el, tagsStr) {
  for (const tag of tagsStr.split(', ')) {
    selectedTags.add(tag);
    const existingCard = document.querySelector(`.tag-card[data-name="${tag}"]`);
    if (existingCard) existingCard.classList.add('selected');
  }
  el.style.opacity = '0.5';
  el.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  updateSelectedBar();
  showToast('已添加组合: ' + tagsStr.replace(/_/g, ' '));
}

function addAllSuggested(tagsStr) {
  for (const tag of tagsStr.split(', ')) {
    selectedTags.add(tag);
    const existingCard = document.querySelector(`.tag-card[data-name="${tag}"]`);
    if (existingCard) existingCard.classList.add('selected');
  }
  updateSelectedBar();
  showToast('已添加全部 ' + tagsStr.split(', ').length + ' 个建议标签');
}

// ===== 历史记录 =====
let _historyData = [];
let _historyFiltered = [];
let _currentDetailItem = null; // 当前查看详情的历史条目
let _historySortDesc = true; // true=最新优先(desc), false=最旧优先(asc)

function openHistory() {
  document.getElementById('historyOverlay').classList.add('active');
  const nickname = currentUser?.nickname || localStorage.getItem('kn');
  if (!nickname) {
    document.getElementById('historyList').innerHTML = '<div class="history-empty">请先登录后再查看历史记录</div>';
    return;
  }
  const cached = localStorage.getItem('history_cache_' + nickname);
  if (cached) {
    try {
      _historyData = JSON.parse(cached);
      _historyFiltered = [..._historyData];
      renderHistoryList();
    } catch {}
  }
  fetchHistory(nickname);
}

function closeHistory() {
  document.getElementById('historyOverlay').classList.remove('active');
}

async function fetchHistory(nickname) {
  const listEl = document.getElementById('historyList');
  if (!_historyData.length) {
    listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="history-loading"><div class="spinner"></div><div>正在加载历史记录…</div></div>';
  }
  try {
    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + '/api/history/' + encodeURIComponent(nickname));
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const data = await res.json();
    _historyData = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
    _historyFiltered = [..._historyData];
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('history_cache_' + nickname, JSON.stringify(_historyData));
    } catch {}
    renderHistoryList();
  } catch (e) {
    listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="history-empty">加载失败: ' + escHtml(e.message) + '<br>点击重新加载</div>';
  }
}

function renderHistoryList() {
  const listEl = document.getElementById('historyList');
  let sorted = [..._historyFiltered];
  sorted.sort((a, b) => {
    const ta = a.timestamp || '';
    const tb = b.timestamp || '';
    return _historySortDesc ? tb.localeCompare(ta) : ta.localeCompare(tb);
  });
  if (!sorted.length) {
    listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="history-empty">暂无搜索记录，快去搜索吧！</div>';
    return;
  }
  listEl.innerHTML = sorted.map(function(item, idx) {
    const time = formatTime(item.timestamp);
    const input = escHtml(item.user_input || '--');
    const count = item.result_count ?? 0;
    const dur = item.duration_ms != null ? Math.round(item.duration_ms) + 'ms' : '--';
    const cached = item.cached ? '🟢 缓存' : '🔵 实时';
    return '<div class="history-item" onclick="showHistoryDetailByIndex(' + idx + ')">' +
      '<div class="history-item-time">' + time + '</div>' +
      '<div class="history-item-input">' + input + '</div>' +
      '<div class="history-item-meta">' +
        '<span>🏷️ ' + escHtml(String(count)) + ' 个标签</span>' +
        '<span>⏱️ ' + escHtml(dur) + '</span>' +
        '<span>' + cached + '</span>' +
      '</div>' +
    '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

function toggleHistorySort() {
  _historySortDesc = !_historySortDesc;
  const btn = document.getElementById('historySortBtn');
  btn.textContent = _historySortDesc ? '🕐 最新优先' : '🕐 最旧优先';
  renderHistoryList();
}

function filterHistory() {
  const kw = document.getElementById('historySearchInput').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!kw) {
    _historyFiltered = [..._historyData];
  } else {
    _historyFiltered = _historyData.filter(item =>
      (item.user_input || '').toLowerCase().includes(kw)
    );
  }
  renderHistoryList();
}

function showHistoryDetailByIndex(idx) {
  let sorted = [..._historyFiltered];
  sorted.sort(function(a, b) {
    var ta = a.timestamp || '';
    var tb = b.timestamp || '';
    return _historySortDesc ? tb.localeCompare(ta) : ta.localeCompare(tb);
  });
  var item = sorted[idx];
  if (!item) return;
  _currentDetailItem = item;
  document.getElementById('historyOverlay').classList.remove('active');
  var inputEl = document.getElementById('historyDetailInput');
  inputEl.textContent = item.user_input || '--';
  var tagsEl = document.getElementById('historyDetailTags');
  var tags = Array.isArray(item.tags) ? item.tags : [];
  if (!tags.length) {
    tagsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="history-detail-no-tags">暂无词条记录（旧数据未保存 tags）</div>';
  } else {
    tagsEl.innerHTML = tags.map(function(t) {
      var tagName = typeof t === 'string' ? t : (t.name || t);
      return '<span class="history-tag" data-name="' + escHtml(tagName) + '" onclick="toggleHistoryTag(this)">' + escHtml(tagName.replace(/_/g, ' ')) + '</span>';
    }).join('');
  }
  document.getElementById('historyDetailOverlay').classList.add('active');
}

function showHistoryDetail(item) {
  _currentDetailItem = item;
  document.getElementById('historyOverlay').classList.remove('active');

  // 显示输入描述
  const inputEl = document.getElementById('historyDetailInput');
  inputEl.textContent = item.user_input || '--';

  // 显示 tags
  const tagsEl = document.getElementById('historyDetailTags');
  const tags = Array.isArray(item.tags) ? item.tags : [];
  if (!tags.length) {
    tagsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="history-detail-no-tags">暂无词条记录（历史数据无 tags 字段）</div>';
  } else {
    tagsEl.innerHTML = tags.map(t => {
      const tagName = typeof t === 'string' ? t : (t.name || t);
      const tagCat = (typeof t === 'object' && t.category) ? t.category : '';
      return '<span class="history-tag" data-name="' + escHtml(tagName) + '" onclick="toggleHistoryTag(this)">' + escHtml(tagName.replace(/_/g, ' ')) + '</span>';
    }).join('');
  }

  document.getElementById('historyDetailOverlay').classList.add('active');
}

function closeHistoryDetail() {
  document.getElementById('historyDetailOverlay').classList.remove('active');
  _currentDetailItem = null;
}

function toggleHistoryTag(el) {
  el.classList.toggle('selected');
}

function copyHistoryDetailTags() {
  const selected = document.querySelectorAll('#historyDetailTags .history-tag.selected');
  const tags = selected.length
    ? Array.from(selected).map(el => el.dataset.name)
    : Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#historyDetailTags .history-tag')).map(el => el.dataset.name);
  const text = tags.join(', ');
  if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => showToast('已复制 ' + tags.length + ' 个标签'));
  } else {
    showToast('复制失败，请手动选择');
  }
}

  document.querySelectorAll('#historyDetailTags .history-tag').forEach(el => el.classList.add('selected'));
  showToast('已选中全部标签');
}

function reuseFromDetail() {
  if (!_currentDetailItem) return;
  const input = _currentDetailItem.user_input || '';
  if (input) {
    document.getElementById('userInput').value = input;
    document.getElementById('userInput').dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
    closeHistoryDetail();
    searchTags();
  }
}

function reuseHistory(item) {

  if (input) {
    document.getElementById('userInput').value = input;
    document.getElementById('userInput').dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
    closeHistory();
    searchTags();
  }
}

function formatTime(ts) {
  if (!ts) return '--';
  try {
    const d = new Date(ts);
    const now = new Date();
    const diff = now - d;
    if (diff < 60000) return '刚刚';
    if (diff < 3600000) return Math.floor(diff / 60000) + ' 分钟前';
    if (diff < 86400000) return Math.floor(diff / 3600000) + ' 小时前';
    if (diff < 604800000) return Math.floor(diff / 86400000) + ' 天前';
    const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    const h = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
    const min = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
    if (d.getFullYear() === now.getFullYear()) return m + '-' + day + ' ' + h + ':' + min;
    const y = d.getFullYear();
    return y + '-' + m + '-' + day + ' ' + h + ':' + min;
  } catch { return '--'; }
}
